literal_meaning: পিঠ পুড়ছে, ফিরে শু/শো এর আদ্যাক্ষর (back burning, turn and sleep initials)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটা অলস যে পিপুফিশু বলে ডাকা যায়।
কাজ না করে শুধু শুয়ে থাকা তার পিপুফিশু জীবনযাপন।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so lazy that he can be called Pipufishu.
Lying around without working is his Pipufishu lifestyle.
history: This idiom is a modern Bengali acronym derived from 'পিঠ পুড়ছে, ফিরে শু' (back is burning, turn and sleep), humorously capturing extreme laziness in everyday rural or semi-urban settings.
note: Primarily used in informal, spoken Bengali to mock indolence.
